scope: Brazilian Portuguese papers and federal guidance containing precast or prestressed bridge-beam section information. These records are research leads, not implemented national profiles.

records.title_original: Avaliação de viga de concreto pré-moldado para tabuleiro de ponte rodoviária
records.title_en: Assessment of a precast concrete beam for a highway bridge deck
records.locator: 2016 undergraduate thesis; PDF pp. 35–36, Figures 8–10 and the defined I-section; abstract pp. 6–7
records.printed_dimensions: The thesis defines one Brazilian highway-bridge prestressed I section for a 5–25 m study, with 0.50–1.50 m beam spacing and eight strand arrangements. The complete drawing dimensions are in the thesis figures and require visual transcription.
records.missing_information: Render Figures 8–10 and transcribe every ordinate, chamfer and talão (bottom bulb) dimension. Keep this as a study-specific Brazilian profile unless an independent producer or agency source shows wider adoption.
records.contact_route: UFC Structural Engineering and Civil Construction Department; thesis URI riufc/68766

records.organisation: Revista IBRACON de Estruturas e Materiais; Universidade de São Paulo / Instituto Mauá
records.title_original: Análise de confiabilidade de uma viga pré-moldada protendida de ponte dimensionada no estado limite de serviço preconizado pela NBR 6118 e 7188
records.title_en: Reliability analysis of a prestressed bridge beam designed to Brazilian standards
records.locator: Revista IBRACON 13(2), 2020, DOI 10.1590/S1983-41952020000200010; Table 1 geometry and Figures 4–5; open PDF mirror at USP
records.printed_dimensions: The paper studies five prestressed precast U-section bridge beams for a 33.5 m simply supported span. Its Table 1 reports area 556,000 mm² at transfer and 934,000 mm² in operation, with I = 159×10^9 and 348×10^9 mm⁴; the drawing dimensions remain to be transcribed.
records.missing_information: Retrieve the full article PDF and inspect the U-section figure, including the cast-in-place slab contribution and whether the reported operation geometry is composite. Do not treat the operation section as a gross precast profile without separating the slab.
records.contact_route: SciELO article DOI 10.1590/S1983-41952020000200010; USP repository PDF mirror

records.organisation: Departamento Nacional de Infraestrutura de Transportes (DNIT)
records.title_original: IPR 751/2022 — Manual de Projeto de Pontes Semipermanentes
records.title_en: IPR 751/2022 — Manual for design of semipermanent bridges
records.locator: official DNIT annex, PDF p. 4; section on Pontes em Concreto Protendido (PCP)
family_names: DNIT PCP prestressed I/T longitudinal beams
records.printed_dimensions: DNIT describes precast prestressed longitudinal beams with I or T sections and typical spans of 10, 15 and 20 m in federal-road semipermanent bridges. It does not provide a reusable complete beam outline in this annex.
records.missing_information: Locate the referenced IPR 751/2022 bridge album and PCP drawings, then determine whether DNIT publishes standard beam shapes or only project-level design guidance.
records.contact_route: DNIT IPR manuals and PROARTE document archive

records.organisation: Instituto Federal do Espírito Santo / IFES
records.title_original: Estudo de caso: viga I protendida da ponte sobre Córrego São Domingos
records.title_en: Case study: prestressed I girder of the São Domingos Creek bridge
records.locator: PDF p.20–22, Figure 7 and Figure 8; project drawing source dated 2016; bridge on ES-010, Conceição da Barra, Espírito Santo
records.printed_dimensions: Indexed figure description gives a 1,300 mm overall I-girder depth, 600 mm top width, 450 mm bottom width, 200 mm web, 300 mm upper block and 850 mm web-height callout, with 75/100 mm transition labels. The bridge has six prestressed girders over a 20.10 m span.
records.missing_information: Retrieve the original IFES PDF or engineering drawing at readable resolution and resolve the transition dimension chain before implementation. The indexed description may conflate horizontal offsets and vertical depths; do not infer the polygon from the summary alone.
records.contact_route: IFES repository item 123456789/2795; ES-010 project engineering archive
